run.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.probe_base(id INT IDENTITY NOT NULL,v INT,nn INT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO dbo.probe_base(v,nn) VALUES(NULL,1),(2,2)
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_direct AS SELECT id,v,nn FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_aggregate AS SELECT MIN(v) AS m,MAX(nn) AS n,COUNT(v) AS c,SUM(v) AS s FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_nested AS SELECT m,n,c,s FROM dbo.probe_aggregate
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_alias(x,y,z) AS SELECT id,v,nn FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_expression AS SELECT 1 AS literal,id+1 AS changed_id,CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS converted_id,v+1 AS changed_v,ISNULL(v,0) AS filled FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_constant AS SELECT 1 AS literal,CAST(NULL AS INT) AS absent
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_expression
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_constant
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_union AS SELECT nn AS result FROM dbo.probe_base UNION ALL SELECT nn FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_group AS SELECT nn FROM dbo.probe_base GROUP BY nn
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_window AS SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY id) AS rn,SUM(v) OVER() AS total FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_typed AS SELECT CAST('12:34:56.1234567' AS TIME(7)) AS t,CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(12,3)) AS d,CAST(1 AS SQL_VARIANT) AS v
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_union ORDER BY result
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_group ORDER BY nn
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_window ORDER BY rn
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_typed
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_aggregate_expression AS SELECT CAST(MIN(v) AS BIGINT) AS converted,MIN(v)+1 AS changed,ISNULL(MIN(v),0) AS filled FROM dbo.probe_base
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_cte_expression AS WITH c AS (SELECT CAST('12:34' AS TIME) AS t,1 AS n) SELECT t,n FROM c
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_derived_expression AS SELECT t,n FROM (SELECT CAST('12:34' AS TIME) AS t,1 AS n) d
CREATE VIEW dbo.probe_nested_expression AS SELECT t,d,v FROM dbo.probe_typed
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_aggregate_expression
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_cte_expression
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_derived_expression
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested_expression
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_direct
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_aggregate
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_alias
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested WHERE 1=0
BEGIN TRAN
ALTER VIEW dbo.probe_aggregate AS SELECT v AS m,nn AS n,v AS c,v AS s FROM dbo.probe_base
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_aggregate
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested
ROLLBACK
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_aggregate
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested
ALTER VIEW dbo.probe_aggregate AS SELECT v AS m,nn AS n,v AS c,v AS s FROM dbo.probe_base
SELECT * FROM dbo.probe_nested
EXEC sp_refreshview N'dbo.probe_nested'
